purpose: Implement and prove a repository review gate that requires exact-head Codex review, resolved current findings and terminal green CI before automated merge.
requiredInvariants: A completed Codex review must be bound to the exact current PR head SHA.
Current unresolved non-outdated review threads block automated merge.
CHANGES_REQUESTED remains blocking until approval or dismissal by that reviewer.
Pending or red substantive exact-head CI/status checks block automated merge.
Every generated or state-advance merge rechecks review and CI immediately before its SHA-bound merge mutation.
Every Company OS merge controller requires the same exact-head Codex review and current-thread clearance before its SHA-bound merge mutation.
A head change invalidates previous review evidence and stale gate labels cannot become final authority.
